notes: Futura Inteligencia 'terceira rodada de outubro', released as Futura/100% Cidades. TSE registrant is 100% CIDADES PARTICIPACOES LTDA (every '100 CIDADES' BR registration is a Futura poll). Numbers read from Futura's own 18-page PDF report (embedded in the CNN article): CATI phone, 2,000 interviews, field 16-17 Oct, registration BR-06715/2026 on every page. Stimulated: Flavio 48.3, Lula 47.5, Ninguem/Branco/Nulo 2.4, NS/NR/Indeciso 1.9; valid: Flavio 50.4, Lula 49.6. Spontaneous: Flavio 46.5, Lula 46.1. The CNN article (19 Oct) has copy-paste errors: its subtitle says field 14-15 Oct and it cites protocol BR-03764/2026, which belongs to the previous round (14-15 Oct, released 16 Oct, Flavio 50.8 / Lula 49.2 valid). Its methodology paragraph does say 16-17 Oct. CNN says the poll used the institute's own funds ('recursos proprios'), so sponsor is null. Not in the Wikipedia seed as of 20 Oct 04:35 UTC.
